description: Region Instance Metadata Defaults with an Excessive Hop Limit
rationale: The hop limit is the IP time-to-live of the metadata service response, and one hop reaches the instance and nothing else. Set higher in the account-level defaults, the metadata service of every instance launched without a hop limit of its own answers past the instance: a container on a bridged or overlay network reaches it, and so does any process able to make the instance forward a request. The credentials of the instance profile then stop belonging to the instance and belong to whatever runs on it, which is exactly the boundary a container platform is supposed to keep.
remediation: Set the region's instance metadata defaults to a hop limit of 1, with ModifyInstanceMetadataDefaults, and raise it only on the individual instances whose container networking genuinely needs a second hop
